text:
Silver Price in 2010
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2010, the LBMA silver price rose 88.0% between 2010-01-29 ($16.29) and 2010-12-31 ($30.63). The highest sampled price was $30.63 in December and the lowest was $16.12 in February. The mean of these observations was $20.51. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
